title: Sleep records for the appointment
description: Gather the audio clips you choose, the dates and your own notes for a discussion with a specialist.

blocks.text: The user wants to pass observations to a specialist but can’t work out how to open a recording and send the right part. That is a practical job in its own right, and it doesn’t require the app to establish a disease.

quote.text: Absolutely no instructions. I can’t figure out how to hear my recordings. No directions on sending the information to my doctor.

blocks.text: Let them pick dates, their own notes and audio clips. If readings from another device are included, keep their times and where they came from separate. Before it is sent, show what the package contains.

The automatic name of an event must not replace the original material. The person chooses what to share; the app decides neither how the observations are interpreted nor whether an examination is needed.
